instrument: NOT the generated differential harness. `vit test-validate` compares a unit's MAPPED OUTPUTS and `Debug` assigns nothing in its own signature -- `ErrVar` only on GetNewUnit's unit-number-exhaustion arm, which does not exist once GetNewUnit is absorbed, and `avrSWAP` never. A generated harness for this unit would compare the empty set. What is checked here is the unit's actual contract: the BYTES of everything it writes.
measures: FOUR STREAMS, not three. CAN see: every value and every column of the three .RO.dbg files at the exact byte, AND the WRITE(*,100) status line as the driver's fd 1 receives it. The fourth stream was added at the second dispatch and was RED on its first comparison (C12, evidence/Debug/stdout.DEFECT-unflushed-status-record.*): libgfortran emits a preconnected unit's record whole, while a fully-buffered stdout split one record mid-field and delivered eighteen more after the driver's own output. CANNOT see: storage allocated larger than it is read; an out-of-bounds access that lands in padding; a difference that needs a computed double to fall exactly on a constant boundary (1E-99, 1E+99); and any branch no input in this tree reaches. Each is named against the mutant that measures it in evidence/Debug/mutation.md.

dbg.mutcorpus.json (files, scenarios 30-.note: The full comparison is 21 files / 99,293 records / 188,803,532 bytes over scenarios 27-34; 27 and 28 are already counted in the two parts above and are EXCLUDED here so this total does not count them twice. Scenario 29 contributes no file, and that is the finding rather than an omission: DISCON.F90:145 guards the call site with LoggingLevel > 0, so at 0 the unit is never entered.
dbg.mutcorpus.json (files, scenarios 30-.scenarios: 30, 31, 32, 33, 34a, 34b -- the mutation corpus added at the second dispatch

red_tested_note: The `status record left unflushed` row is the C12 defect measured BEFORE its fix and is the reason the stdout stream is in this artifact at all: 46 of scenario 27's 110 stdout records differed. The `143 mutants` row is the mutation sweep read as a red test -- 143 distinct wrong versions of this unit, each rebuilt into libdiscon.so and re-run over the eight-scenario corpus, each moving at least one compared byte. mutation/Debug.json. The two BLIND rows are perturbations this instrument could not see and are kept as rows rather than dropped, because a red test omitted from a table reads as one that was never taken.
